subject: Novapulse integration routing & account-ownership playbook
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novapulse.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Harris <jharris@novapulse.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:14:00 +0000
Subject: Partner routing + account ownership — initial map attached

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I'm attaching a first pass at the account mapping and a short ask: can your team confirm which accounts you consider 'partner-led' vs 'redwood-led' in EMEA? Jason and I flagged several strategic customers (listed in column B) where we believe Novapulse should own the primary commercial relationship if we get joint-sell certification.

Quick asks: 
- Can you confirm one handshake rule for pre-sales (who leads demo / who gets access to the account CRM record)?
- Any regulatory constraints we should be aware of for the Germany accounts?
- Proposed 2-week cadence for sync until mutual MQL handoffs are stable.

Attachment: MAP_Novapulse_Mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with proposed territory, top-50 accounts column, recommended owner, and risk notes).

Looking forward — Elena
Partnerships, Novapulse

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novapulse.io>
Cc: Jason Harris <jharris@novapulse.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Partner routing + account ownership — initial map attached

Elena — thanks for the file and the clear asks.  A few quick confirmations from our side before we loop in ops and sales leadership: 

- Handshake rule (pre-sales): partner-led accounts = Novapulse schedules the initial discovery and owns demo ownership for the first 60 days. Redwood provides a named solutions engineer who joins on request but the partner is primary for outreach. After 60 days, ownership will be reviewed for renewal/expansion.
- CRM access: we'll create a partner role in HubSpot with Partner Liaison permissions for Novapulse reps on partner-led accounts. All activities will be logged; no customer PII export allowed without a signed DPA addendum.
- Germany/regulatory: we need a one-page data residency note from your engineering team for any accounts with EU-specific contracts. Can Jason help with that?

I want to pull in Sergio and Camila to propose a short internal playbook (1-pager) we can share with your GTM teams. I'll start an internal thread and circulate a draft MAP that includes: routing rules, escalation path, and a simple decision tree (Partner-led / Co-sell / Redwood-led).

I'll also assign a tentative deal id for the joint pipeline: DEAL-5891. Can Novapulse confirm top 10 priority accounts so we can lock routing and set touches?

Best,
Mateo
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: FW: Novapulse mapping — draft playbook (internal)

Team — forwarding Novapulse's mapping. Need a quick internal alignment so we can send a crisp one-pager back by EOD tomorrow. Draft requirements: 

1) Routing rules: define clear thresholds for partner-led (ARR > $100k ARR referral by Novapulse), co-sell (shared ownership, joint demo), and redwood-led (inbound from direct marketing).
2) Account stewardship: who owns renewal, who owns upsell motions, and where does commission split live?
3) Escalation: who to loop (sales leader, legal, security) when territory conflicts appear. Propose: first-line escalate to partner-ops (Camila), second-line to Alliances (Sergio), third-line to Revenue Ops (Lauren).
4) Legal/data residency: need a quick checklist to give Novapulse for DE/legal asks.

Camila — can you build the decision tree and export an SVG? Sergio — can you draft an email to Elena confirming the handshake rule and asking for the DE residency note? Lauren — please confirm the commission split template and whether current comp plans need amendment for partner-led accounts.

I know it's quick — 30 minute sync at 10:30 if helpful.

-Mateo

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:36:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: FW: Novapulse mapping — draft playbook (internal)

On Tue, 2 Mar 2027 at 10:05, Mateo Alvarez wrote:
> Team — forwarding Novapulse's mapping. Need a quick internal alignment so we can send a crisp one-pager back by EOD tomorrow.

Attached a first-pass decision tree and proposed escalation contacts. Key notes: 

- Decision tree highlights three gates: ARR size, ownership request from partner, and compliance flag. The compliance flag is binary — if set, account goes to Redwood-led unless a signed SOW includes data residency clauses.
- Escalation matrix: Partner-ops (camila_reyes@redwood.ai) -> Alliances (sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai) -> Revenue Ops (lauren_bishop@redwood.ai) -> Legal.
- Suggested handoff email template included in slide 2.

Attachments referenced: RN_MutualActionPlan_v0.3.docx (1-pager MAP), decision_tree.svg (attached inline).

I'll update with the SVG export after the sync.

-Camila

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novapulse.io>
Cc: Jason Harris <jharris@novapulse.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Partner routing + account ownership — initial map attached

Elena / Jason — thanks for your patience. Attached is our one-page playbook and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) for pilot accounts. High-level agreements: 

- Handshake & routing: Novapulse will be primary on partner-led accounts for the first 60 days. Redwood will provide a named SE and shadow activities in HubSpot. If the account has any EU compliance flag (data residency, contractual restrictions), the default routing is Redwood-reviewed and will only move to partner-led after a signed SOW including residency clauses.
- CRM & comms: Partner Liaison role created; Novapulse will receive Partner Liaison permissions for mapped accounts. No PII export without signed DPA.
- Escalation: first contact Camila (partner-ops), then Sergio (alliances), then Lauren (rev ops). Legal for contract exceptions.
- Pilot accounts: Novapulse confirmed the top five pilot targets in separate email; we agreed to run the pilot for 90 days and evaluate conversion signals for ownership reassignment.

Next steps / asks for Novapulse: 
1) Send the DE residency tech note for the highlighted Germany accounts (Jason) — due: 2027-03-09.
2) Review the attached RN_MutualActionPlan_v0.3.docx and comment inline — due: 2027-03-07.
3) Sign the SOW draft if pilot terms look good; I'll kick it to Legal once we get a thumbs up.

Attachments: RN_MutualActionPlan_v0.3.docx, SOW_draft.pdf, MAP_Novapulse_Mapping_v1.xlsx

I'll schedule recurring 2-week syncs starting 2027-03-16; calendar invite to follow.

Thanks all — Mateo
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
